title: Measure difference on a set difference
statement:
Let $
u_1$ and $
u_2$ be probability measures on $\mathbb R$, and let $t\subseteq s\subseteq\mathbb R$ with $t$ measurable. If $B\in\mathbb R$ satisfies $|
u_1(s)-
u_2(s)|\leq B$ and $|
u_1(t)-
u_2(t)|\leq B$, then $|
u_1(s\setminus t)-
u_2(s\setminus t)|\leq 2B$.
hypotheses_covered: $\nu_1$ and $\nu_2$ are probability measures on $\mathbb R$
